messages:
marta: Quick sync — during q6b-int4 bring-up we saw a reproducible dip on cloning/intent-preserve slices (worst on long-context samples). I think we should do a focused golden refresh + relabel pass before scaling canary.

jonathan: Ack. Do we have a shortlist of slices + current golden coverage?

marta: Shortlist: long-dialogue (>512 tokens), nested instructions, multi-step math prompts, code-infill edges. Current golden covers ~1.2k across those but skewed to shortctx. Want to add ~800 more prioritized by failure weight.

jen: For relabel effort — estimate ~2.5k labels total including verification. How urgent is this for the canary?

marta: Want a tight canary (500–1k) in prod next week. So golden refresh should be prioritized for canary subset (target 600 high-signal examples with double-review). Remaining examples can be queued for normal relabel cadence.

lu: For dedupe: previous hash threshold dropped some near-duplicates that actually matter for longform. Suggest lowering fingerprint sensitivity for the long-dialogue slice and rerun fuzzy dedupe on that partition only.

oliver: Agreed. We can do partitioned dedupe. I can run a pass: `curation-tool export --filter "slice:long-dialogue" | fuzzy-dedupe --min-sim 0.82 --out long-dialogue-candidates.json` and then mark candidates for manual review.

marta: Perfect. For labeling guidelines, use the q6b-int4 guideline doc I updated this morning (see link in #docs). Key changes: accept longer completions as context, stricter hallucination flags, and new instruction-following score bracket.

jen: Can labeler-bot allocate capacity? @labeler-bot what's ETA for 600 double-reviewed items? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

labeler-bot: ETA ~48h if we spin up an extra reviewer pool. Can start immediately if owners approve.

jonathan: I'm happy to approve extra reviewer pool for the canary tranche. @lu / oliver can you estimate dedupe + export time?

lu: Dedupe + export for the targeted slices should be done in ~4 hours if I run on the dedicated job queue. I'll post the artifact link when ready.

oliver: Will also bake a canary eval harness to compare q6b-int4 vs baseline q6b-fp16 on the 600 examples. Output will include token-level diffs and human score flags.

marta: Action items: 1) Lu: run partitioned dedupe and export candidates (4h). 2) Oliver: produce canary eval harness and baseline run (today). 3) Labeling: labeler-bot start double-review of selected 600 after dedupe (48h). 4) Marta/Jonathan: triage failing slices and final go/no-go for canary.

jen: Thanks — I'll block labeler pool and notify ops for capacity.

marta: Thanks team. If anyone sees a major regression slice not listed, drop it here. :rocket:
